All pages on [garden.errbufferoverfl.me](https://garden.errbufferoverfl.me) include a document license under the `#reuse` anchor. For details on how content can be reused, please refer to the licensing information there.

The primary font, **Volume TC**, and the secondary font, **Volume TC Sans**, were both crafted by Tom Chalky. The graphics come from vintage books, vectorized by Tom, and are available in various illustration packages.
